37593.en: Let DEF be intouch triangle. Let (Ob) be the circle centered at B that passes through D and F. Let (Oc) be the circle centered at C that passes through D and E. Let A' be the center of circle DE'F', and define B' and C' cyclically. The finite fixed point of the affine transformation that carries ABC onto A'B'C' is X_37593. (Angel Montesdeoca, September 24, 2020)
